title: Bazaar Markets: The Agentic Ad Engine
description: A deterministic market simulator for studying deception, verification and brand value, built as an evaluation environment for AI agents. Version 1.0.0 is the frozen rule-based baseline: engine 1.0.0, the reference market with one variant per published run, regression digests of 576 chains, the formal model cross-checked against the code, and every rule-based result so far (runs/BASELINE_1_0_0.md). Code is MIT; docs and data (docs/, runs/) are CC BY 4.0. The run caches are archived as a separate dataset.
